name: design-council
description: Human-centered Design Thinking for Codex and ChatGPT with a deeply modeled ten-person Council, evidence-safe inquiry, visible workshop steps, and visual design artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Think wider. Frame better. Build what matters. Design Council preserves the momentum of a promising idea while testing whether it solves the right human problem. It combines an adaptive Stanford d.school-inspired practice, ten persistent fictional collaborators with complete lives and bounded expertise, sealed independent divergence, strict evidence provenance, research-grounded synthetic inquiry, real-human interview workflows, visible workshop checkpoints, visual affinity and process maps, rapid prototypes, and an advisory Build Gate.
defaultPrompt: Challenge this product idea before we build it, then identify the cheapest useful experiment.
Open Inquiry Lab, research this unfamiliar role, and build a Reality Packet before any synthetic interview.
Run a sealed Council round or create a source-linked visual affinity map, preserving dissent and outliers.
